3.why: Travel-agent terms expressly allow the hold for either guest identically and neither party has a prior claim; both guests still travel on the same crossing, so the no-one-else closing is true.

10.why: Read all supplied party-bearing lines and complete bodies: no personal, relative or indefinite pronoun substitutes for a party; object/action pronouns do not refer to parties.
